July 24, 2018
7:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-40
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735
CALL TO ORDER (7:30 PM)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYORâ€™S REPORT â€“ MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 8a-h)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
May 8, 2018; Regular Meeting
b.
July 10, 2018; Special Meeting
Minutes
2.
Demands of July 24, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 â€“ Payroll Warrant of July 13, 2018
b.
Motion #2 â€“ Warrant Register of July 24, 2018
Demands
3.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
4.
Expenditure of Citizen's Options for Public Safety (COPS) Funds and Adoption of Resolution R18-39 Authorizing the Expenditure of COPS Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt R18-39, approving the use of COPS funds and approve the expenditure of $65,000 of COPS funds to purchase Police Department equipment.
Staff Report
5.
Approval of an Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and Michael Baker International for Interim Planning Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the proposed professional agreement with Michael Baker International, in an amount not to exceed $150,000 for interim planning services until the vacant Planning Manager and City Planner positions are filled.
Staff Report
6.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - June 30, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
7.
Summary Report to "Receive and File" on the Filling of a Vacancy in the Police Department with a Captain and Eliminating a Sergeant Position
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
8.
Parklands Committee Meeting Items of July 12, 2018
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
PC-506-18; Application to remove 1 Canary Island Date palm tree located in the parkway adjacent to 868 Via Del Monte
Applicant: Jerry Donahue
864 Rincon Lane
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to remove 1 Canary Island palm tree located in the parkway adjacent to 868 Via Del Monte according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™. Require a $500 payment to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™. (5-0, in favor).
b.
PC-507-18; Application to remove 2 Red Iron Bark Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway adjacent to 736 and 741 Cloyden Road
Applicant: Irv Miller
745 Cloyden Road
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: This application was withdrawn by the applicant. At this time Committee member Wade motioned second by McCabe to direct staff to add an item to the next agenda to address tree trimming costs and permit fees. (5-0, in favor).
c.
PC-509-18; Application to remove 1 Coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1312 Via Margarita
Applicant: Dirk J. Gaudet
1312 Via Margarita
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to remove 1 Coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1312 Via Margarita according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™. Require a $500 payment to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™ and removal of the stump. (5-0, in favor).
d.
PC-510-18; Application to remove 3 Canary Island pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2917 Via Rivera
Applicant: Ed and Terry Poplawski
3000 Via Victoria
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to remove 3 Canary Island pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2917 Via Rivera according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™. Payment of $1,500 to the Tree Bank and removal of the stumps are required. (5-0, in favor).
e.
PC-511-18; Application to remove 2 Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2765 Via Campesina
Applicant: Sunil Adwani
2765 Via Campesina
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to remove 2 Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2765 Via Campesina according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal approvalsâ€™. Payment of $1,000 to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™ and removal of the stumps are required. (4-0-1 in favor, Kaviani recused).
f.
PC-512-18; Application to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the Parklands adjacent to 915 Via Panorama
Applicant: Karen Miller
924 Via Panorama
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the Parklands adjacent to 915 Via Panorama according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™. Require $500 payment to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™ and removal of the stump. (4-1, in favor).
g.
PC-513-18; Application to trim or remove 1 Aleppo pine located in the Parklands adjacent to 2801 Via Segovia
Applicant: Jeff Coppersmith
2801 Via Segovia
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to trim the Aleppo pine tree to lift the branches off the ground and thin the foliage to accent the wind swept character and improve the view. (5-0, in favor).
h.
Consideration of a new â€˜Designated Street Treeâ€™ for Paseo La Cresta west of Via Fernandez, La Cresta Place, Cloyden Road and Cloyden Square.
Action: Recommended approval with modification to approve the Strawberry tree for Paseo La Cresta west of Via Fernandez and La Cresta Place and the Crape Myrtle â€˜Tuscaroraâ€™ for Cloyden Square. Direct staff to provide pictures for the next meeting of the 25 feet mark outside Mr. Irv Millerâ€™s viewing area.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
OLD BUSINESS
11.
Review and Approval of Palos Verdes Stables FY 2018-19 Operating and Capital Budgets and Discussion of Potential Extension of Concession Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the FY 2018-19 Palos Verdes Stable budget, including proposed capital expenditures and provide direction in reference to an extension to the existing concession agreement with HGS.
Staff Report
12.
Exchange of SCE Rule 20A Credits to the City of Rolling Hills in Exchange for General Fund Revenue
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Rolling Hills, subject to the approval of the City Attorney, for the exchange of City of Palos Verdes Estates Rule 20A credits to the City of Rolling Hills, at a discounted rate of $0.60 totaling $600,000 in unencumbered General Fund revenue, and submit a credit transfer authorization letter to Southern California Edison (SCE).
Staff Report
13.
Discussion of Filling the Vacancies on the Investment Policy Advisory Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to staff in regard to how to proceed in filling the vacancies on the Investment Policy Advisory Committee.
Staff Report
14.
Presentation of Malaga Cove Plaza Land Use and Economic Development Study
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council â€œreceive and fileâ€ the attached study and provide any further direction to staff.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
15.
Consideration and Approval of Including a Monthly Cash-Flow Statement in the 2018-2020 Budget Document, and Preparation of a Quarterly Reconciliation of Revenues and Expenses
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider and provide direction for a monthly cash flow schedule in the fiscal year 2018-2020 budget document and quarterly reconciliation of revenues and expenses.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
16.
City Manager's Report
PUBLIC HEARINGS/ORDINANCE(S)
All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3) minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5) minutes for presentation and rebuttal.
9.
County Weed Abatement Charges For FY 17/18
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and confirm the charges as contained in the attached report prepared by the Los Angeles County Agricultural Commissioner/Weights & Measures for providing weed abatement services for Fiscal Year 17/18.
Staff Report
10.
Reintroduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. 18-734; an Ordinance of the City Council Amending Sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to Define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to Establish Procedures and Standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family Residential Zones
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council reintroduce upon first reading Ordinance No. 18-734 amending sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to establish procedures and standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family residential zones.
Staff Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
17.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 6, 2018, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF AN ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING.
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 20th day of July, 2018.
